facts.label: Cena e ação no passado
facts.sub: Use was/were + -ing para a cena em andamento e o passado simples para a ação curta: I was watering the flowers when I saw it. Pergunte Was it making a sound?

facts.label: Passado contínuo
facts.sub: Para uma ação em andamento no passado, use was/were + verbo com -ing: I was watering the flowers. She was flying above us. É a cena de fundo da história, a ação que ainda estava acontecendo.

facts.label: Ação curta
facts.sub: Para uma ação curta que interrompe a cena, use o passado simples: I saw it. It fell. Una as duas partes com when: I was watering the flowers when I saw it. Depois de when, o verbo fica no passado simples.

pages.title: Mito ou fato? · 1/2

items.s: Fell is the past of fall.
“I was watering” talks about an action in progress.
We say “I was water the flowers”.

pages.instruction: Decida e explique com suas palavras.

solo: Aluno responde e justifica; você mostra a pista.
group: Cada aluno decide sozinho, depois compare as respostas e peça uma justificativa.
Corrija pela pista do texto, não só dizendo “certo/errado”.
extra90: Peça que cada aluno invente uma pergunta igual para o colega.
answers: Fell is the past of fall. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)
“I was watering” talks about an action in progress. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)
We say “I was water the flowers”. → Falso (We say I was watering.)

“Nina, look! There’s a baby bird under the tree.” says Hugo. “Oh no! It fell from the nest.” says Nina. “I was watering the flowers when I saw it.” says Hugo.
